item.title: Precision Engineering Roots and Global Solutions
item.description:
Precision Engineering Roots and Global Solutions
#

AUTOGRIP Machinery Co., Ltd. has been a dedicated specialist in the field of power chucks and rotary cylinders since its establishment in 1989. With a focus on delivering high rigidity and precision, AUTOGRIP has consistently provided hydraulic lathe chucks and related products that meet the demanding standards of the machinery industry.

item.title: Innovative Manual Chucks for Enhanced Machining Performance
item.description:
Innovative Manual Chucks for Enhanced Machining Performance
#

AUTOGRIP® introduces its first thin manual chuck, engineered with a focus on lightweight construction and a compact form factor. This new design stands out from traditional manual chucks by offering an expanded Z-axis processing range, which is especially beneficial for complex machining tasks.

item.title: Comprehensive Overview of Power Chucks for Precision Machining
item.description:
Power Chuck Solutions for Modern Manufacturing
#

Autogrip®, established in Taiwan since 1989, has become a recognized name in power chuck manufacturing, collaborating with machine builders worldwide. The power chuck product line is engineered to offer flexibility, adaptability, and precision for a wide range of machining applications.

item.title: Comprehensive CNC Chuck Solutions for Precision Machining
item.description:

#

At AUTOGRIP Machinery, our commitment centers on innovation and excellence in CNC lathe chuck technology. With over 35 years of expertise, we continuously invest in advanced equipment and technologies across research and development, production, quality control, and sales. Our goal is to provide reliable, high-precision clamping solutions tailored to the evolving needs of the machining industry.

item.title: Solutions for Complex Clamping Needs in Machining
item.description:
Advanced Clamping Solutions for Unique Machining Challenges
#

AUTOGRIP® offers a diverse selection of special purpose power chucks engineered to address the specific needs of complex workpieces and specialized machining operations. These chucks are meticulously designed to provide optimal stability and cutting efficiency, making them ideal for tasks such as milling and drilling where conventional clamping may fall short.

item.title: Precision Workholding Solutions for Machining Centers
item.description:
Reliable Workpiece Holding for Enhanced Machining Accuracy
#

AUTOGRIP®’s stationary chucks are essential components in machining and industrial environments, designed to securely hold and grip workpieces during various operations. These chucks feature jaws that can be adjusted to tightly grip or release a workpiece, ensuring stability and precision throughout the machining process. Typically mounted on lathes or other machine tools, stationary chucks play a vital role in maintaining the correct position and orientation of workpieces, which is crucial for achieving consistent and accurate results.
